title: Merge overlapping intervals
description:
src/intervals.py has a function merge_intervals(intervals) that takes a list of [start, end] pairs and returns the smallest list of pairs that covers exactly the same ground, sorted by start.

The input may arrive in any order, so the function cannot assume it is sorted. Two intervals that merely touch, such as [1, 2] and [2, 3], cover a continuous range and must come back as a single interval [1, 3]. An interval completely inside another disappears into it. An empty input gives an empty list.

The function must raise ValueError if any interval has a start greater than its end. It must not modify the list it is given, nor the pairs inside it.

Some of the tests in tests/test_visible.py are failing. Find out why and fix src/intervals.py.
